ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; dominant low-intensity black pigmentation with approximately 5-8% high-intensity white pixel coverage localized in speckling and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black base. High-contrast white geometric clusters at distal lobe tips (X,Y extents). Stochastic distribution of white circular micro-blobs (mottling) localized primarily on the left lobe and lower central fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 48 degrees; apex is sharply defined and centrally located.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular; left lobe trailing edge contains five distinct macro-peaks (sawtooth profile). Right lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations transitioning to a smoother curve near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit an upward convex curve; trailing edge follows a deep concave trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters at distal tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization). Secondary detection of small, roughly circular high-contrast spots scattered across the left fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss/jagged serration on the left lobe trailing edge. Dense parasitic barnacle encrustation on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-amplitude serration pattern on the medial-left trailing edge.
